Dashboard_Subtitle: Live hardware timer diagnostics, esports latency status, and 1-click system acceleration.
Dashboard_QuickBoost_Desc: Executes full end-to-end performance acceleration: safely generates a Windows System Restore Point, unlocks the Ultimate Performance power scheme, optimizes Network Throttling Index & Multimedia scheduling, cleans temp/shader caches, and disables Game DVR.
Dashboard_Safety_Desc: Capivara Booster automatically creates a Windows System Restore Point (Checkpoint-Computer) and takes immutable configuration file backups before executing any debloating, registry modifications, or game patches.
Debloat_Subtitle: Safely remove pre-installed UWP bloatware packages, stop diagnostic tracking services, and eliminate background telemetry tasks.
Debloat_Telemetry_Desc: Disables DiagTrack (Connected User Experiences and Telemetry), dmwappushservice, Customer Experience tasks (Consolidator, UsbCeip), and Windows Compatibility Appraiser to stop disk thrashing and DPC interrupt spikes.
Debloat_Uwp_Desc: Select unwanted provisioned packages to remove from the current user account and online system provisioning.
Cleaner_Subtitle: Purge temporary files, Windows Update download leftovers, GPU shader caches, and flush DNS records to eliminate frametime stuttering.
SystemBoost_Subtitle: Hardware timer tuning (HPET), Windows power scheduling, network throttling bypass, and global game optimization flags.
SystemBoost_Hpet_Desc: Disabling HPET in the BCD boot store (useplatformclock=false) and Device Manager forces Windows to utilize the CPU's invariant TSC (Time Stamp Counter). This significantly minimizes micro-stutter, reduces frametime variance, and lowers DPC/ISR driver latency in competitive FPS titles.
SystemBoost_Power_Desc: Unlocks the hidden OEM/Workstation 'Ultimate Performance' scheme (powercfg -duplicatescheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61). It disables CPU core parking, locks clock states to eliminate frequency scaling delays, and disables aggressive peripheral power savings.
SystemBoost_Tweaks_Desc: Optimizes Windows kernel scheduling, packet processing, and eliminates background interference.
SystemBoost_Startup_Desc: Programs configured to launch automatically on Windows boot (Run registry keys).
GameOpt_Subtitle: Tailored low-latency engine configurations, registry priority overrides, and shader cache cleans for competitive titles.
GameOpt_PriorityLabel: CPU Priority: High (Class 3) & Affinity: Mask Core 0 (0xFFFFFFFE)
GameOpt_PriorityDesc: Forces executable to High execution priority in kernel scheduler; masks out Core 0 to isolate from OS DPC/interrupts.
GameOpt_FseLabel: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations & Override High DPI Scaling
GameOpt_FseDesc: Injects DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE and HIGHDPIAWARE layers to eliminate DWM input latency.
GameOpt_ShaderDesc: Deletes stale compiled pipeline binaries to prevent shader compilation stutter after game updates.
CS2_Autoexec_Label: Generate Esports autoexec.cfg (De-subtick binds, net buffers, rate 786432)
CS2_Autoexec_Desc: Creates an optimized autoexec.cfg with 128-tick interpolation, instant jumpthrow aliases, engine low latency tick sleep, and disables tracers.
Val_RiotLow_Label: Set Riot Client (RiotClientServices.exe) to Low Priority
Val_RiotLow_Desc: Drops the auxiliary Riot Client telemetry process to Idle priority, preventing it from stealing CPU cycles mid-match.
Val_Logs_Label: Purge Valorant Saved Crash Reports & Debug Logs
Val_Logs_Desc: Cleans %LOCALAPPDATA%\VALORANT\Saved\Logs, Crashes, and webcache to eliminate file handle overhead.
Val_Defender_Label: Add Windows Defender Exclusions for Vanguard (vgk.sys) and Riot Games
Val_Defender_Desc: Prevents Windows Antivirus real-time monitoring from constantly scanning Vanguard kernel drivers and game assets.
LoL_LowSpec_Label: Force 'Low Spec Mode' and 'Close Client During Game' in game.cfg & PersistedSettings.json
LoL_LowSpec_Desc: Terminates the Chromium-based LeagueClientUx process while in a match, freeing up 1.5GB+ RAM and reducing frametime spikes in teamfights.
LoL_Logs_Label: Clear League of Legends Logs & Riot Client Logs
LoL_Logs_Desc: Purges legacy game logs and network dump files from the installation directory.
LoL_Defender_Label: Add Windows Defender Exclusions for League of Legends Directory
LoL_Defender_Desc: Exempts League of Legends executables and assets from live Defender disk inspection.
Backup_Subtitle: Create Windows System Restore Points, restore game configuration files, and revert modified registry values to defaults.
Backup_RestorePoint_Desc: Creates an immediate hardware and driver snapshot via Checkpoint-Computer. Capivara Booster automatically unlocks the 24-hour Windows restriction to allow immediate restore points.
Backup_Registry_Desc: Capivara Booster captures an immutable snapshot of every single registry key and value before modifying it. Pressing Revert restores every original state in reverse order.
Backup_Files_Desc: Historical backups of autoexec.cfg, game.cfg, and PersistedSettings.json taken prior to applying tweaks.
SystemBoost_Tweak1_Desc: Disables packet throttling during non-multimedia tasks, removing packet queues and smoothing ping.
SystemBoost_Tweak2_Title: Disable Game DVR & Background Capture Hooks
SystemBoost_Tweak2_Desc: Eliminates Xbox Game DVR background encoding that steals GPU encoder bandwidth and creates input lag.
SystemBoost_Tweak3_Desc: Prevents DWM compositing layer injection, granting direct exclusive display access.
SystemBoost_Tweak4_Desc: Blocks idle UWP applications and search app tasks from waking up and interrupting active gaming threads.
